classes.name: ThreadSafeCounter
classes.description: A thread-safe class that holds a counter with methods to increment, get value, and wait until the counter reaches a certain value.

methods.name: Increment
methods.description: Increments the counter in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the current value of the counter in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: WaitUntilGreaterOrEqual
methods.description: Blocks until the counter reaches at least the specified value.
